teaser: Eight is the number of the ledger and the long reach for more — not more for its own sake, but mastery proven in dollars, title, and the room that quiets when you walk in. ESFJ is the type built to hold a group together, warm and dutiful, more comfortable earning belonging than earning rank. Cross them and you get someone who wants to run the operation and be loved for running it well — a hand that signs the checks and also remembers every birthday in the office. The push for power sits oddly next to the need to be needed, and most weeks you find a way to make both true at once.
excerpt: The rental car smells like someone else's air freshener, and the mirror gets adjusted, the best route found, dinner stops planned before your partner has finished buckling in.
